events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and secure access
events.decision: Can the team access finance, purchasing and inventory data and staff from week 1?
agenda: Present the problem statement and the three phases
Review the data and people the diagnostic needs in weeks 1 to 3
Decide how the team gets access to data and staff

events.label: Check-in: process maps
events.purpose: Review process maps and gaps to close
events.decision: Which process areas need more detail before the requirements sign-off?
agenda: Present finance, purchasing and inventory process maps
Review requirements captured and the gaps still open
Decide which process areas need more detail before sign-off

events.label: Requirements sign-off
events.decision: Approve the requirements and go to vendor selection?
agenda: Present the consolidated requirements and fit-gap
Review how the requirements cover finance, purchasing and inventory
Decide whether to approve the requirements and start vendor selection

events.label: Check-in: vendor scoring
events.decision: Which vendors from the scoring go into the business case?
agenda: Present the vendor shortlist and demonstration findings
Review vendor scoring against the approved requirements
Decide which vendors the business case covers

events.label: Vendor selection
events.decision: Which ERP vendor goes forward into implementation?
agenda: Present the business case with vendor scoring
Review vendor scores and demonstration findings
Decide which ERP vendor goes forward into implementation

events.label: Check-in: build progress
events.purpose: Review finance and purchasing build results
events.decision: Which open test findings must close before ERP readiness testing begins?
agenda: Present the finance and purchasing configuration and test record
Review test results and open findings
Decide which findings close before readiness testing

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Check readiness before the pilot goes live
events.decision: Go or no-go on the pilot go-live at the pilot pharmacy and warehouse?
agenda: Present inventory configuration and readiness test results
Review data migration rehearsal and reconciliation results
Decide whether the pilot pharmacy and warehouse go live

events.label: Check-in: pilot results
events.purpose: Review pilot results before the first wave
events.decision: Does the pilot stability report support starting the first rollout wave?
agenda: Present the pilot go-live record and stability report
Review pilot stability and issues raised since go-live
Decide whether the first rollout wave starts

events.label: Check-in: pilot close-out
events.purpose: Review pilot close-out and open issues
events.decision: Which open pilot issues must close before the next rollout wave goes live?
agenda: Present the pilot close-out record and open-issue log
Review which pilot issues remain open
Decide which open issues close before the next wave

events.label: Workshop 2: remaining waves
events.purpose: Review first waves and remaining waves
events.decision: Go or no-go on the remaining rollout waves after the first waves' results?
agenda: Present go-live records for the first rollout waves
Review the pilot reports and open-issue log
Decide whether the remaining rollout waves go ahead

events.label: Check-in: rollout status
events.purpose: Review rollout status ahead of acceptance
events.decision: Which open rollout issues must close before final acceptance?
agenda: Present the rollout status report and open-issue log
Review progress toward all 40 pharmacies and both warehouses live
Decide which open issues close before final acceptance

events.label: Final acceptance
events.purpose: Accept the ERP across all sites
events.decision: Approve the ERP as running in all 40 pharmacies and both warehouses?
agenda: Present the final acceptance pack for all sites and month-end close
Review the rollout status report and remaining open issues
Decide whether to approve the ERP as running across all sites
